description: This file defines a subclass MySQL80Platform that extends Doctrine's MySQL80Platform, overriding the hasNativeJsonType method to return false. It is part of a custom platform implementation for MySQL 8.0 within the OrangeHRM project.

classes.name: MySQL80Platform
classes.description: A custom subclass of Doctrine's MySQL80Platform that disables native JSON type support.

methods.name: hasNativeJsonType
methods.description: Overrides the parent method to indicate this platform does not support native JSON types.
